annotations.title: Score how much of a text is fluff

description: Checks a memo, email, post, report or AI-written draft for fluff: pleasantries and throat-clearing, stock openers ("in today's fast-paced world"), padding ("it's important to note that"), buzzwords (leverage, synergy, robust), hedges, vague claims and sentences that repeat an earlier one. Returns a 0-100 fluff percentage, a verdict, every flagged sentence with the reason, the most used filler phrases, and the gist (only the lines that say something, with padding phrases trimmed). Rule-based wording check, not a fact check; it never invents text.

text.description: The text to check (up to 60,000 characters).

name: fluff_check_text
